collection.title: Ford S-Max 2009 to 2014 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A Ford S-Max 2009 to 2014 model requires a 26" wiper blade for the drivers and a 30" for the passengers side with a Push Button arm attachment. All of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. We also offer a choice of rear screen wipers for this S-Max which can be viewed by clicking on the Rear Screen Wiper Blade tab below.
